priorExposure: The same market history has already been inspected for failed add-score-v1 and entry-percentile-knn-v1. Temporal partitions below are historical replication, not a genuinely untouched holdout.

signal.reference: daily constant target-weight CNY total-return reference including zero-interest strategic cash; used only for signals, never as the tradable account
signal.execution: signal uses strictly preceding common close; execute at next common close; no carried product price for trades
signal.drawdown: relative to running peak of all reference history, not reset at episode start

benchmarks.allocation: split each arrival's risk budget into three equal initial sub-lots; each earns its own waiting interest

funding.monthly_new_cash: 100 arrives on first common close of each calendar month in [start, anniversary); never on or after anniversary
funding.budget: Each deposit sets aside exactly 40% strategic cash. Remaining 60% including its waiting interest funds product purchases in 1:1 proportions and all buy fees. Never borrow, sell, or use future deposits. Outstanding lots are kept separate and can remain cash at terminal date.
funding.deadline: Lot buys when preceding-close feature <= fixed threshold or common-session index minus arrival index >= maxWait. Deadline does not depend on future episode end.

episodes.start: first common close of every calendar month with at least 200 strictly preceding reference observations
episodes.end: first common close on/after start anniversary, at most 14 calendar days later; fixed from funding date, not purchase date; all positions liquidated on that date
episodes.purge: Both funding start and full terminal outcome must lie inside the same partition; no boundary-crossing episode; signal may use prior history.

accounting.prices: individual actual adjusted total-return asset prices converted to CNY with same-day or earlier FX no older than 7 calendar days; per-asset units drift between purchases; no synthetic backfilled leveraged history
accounting.cashInterest: both strategic and pending cash earn same hypothetical net annual rate compounded by actual calendar days/365.2425; 2% is sensitivity, not historical cash-rate evidence
accounting.fees: proportional per-asset on every purchase and terminal sale, funded from available cash; adjusted asset prices already include product expenses
accounting.tax: phase-one screens use pre-personal-tax returns. A surviving candidate still requires actual dividend evidence and production-equivalent personal-tax validation before integration; cannot be called after-tax improvement.
accounting.drawdown: cash-flow-unitized account NAV, including fees and all pending/strategic cash; deposits issue units at pre-deposit NAV; terminal liquidation included

metricDefinitions.accountReturn: 100 * (terminal liquidated wealth / total contributions - 1); capital result, not annualized or time-weighted return
metricDefinitions.p10Difference: quantile(candidate account returns, 0.1) minus quantile(immediate account returns, 0.1); also report paired-delta P10 separately for diagnosis
metricDefinitions.drawdownDifference: candidate median/min of signed negative max drawdowns minus immediate median/min; positive means improvement
metricDefinitions.bootstrap: Mulberry32 seed 0x6d2b79f5 reset per summary, non-circular consecutive 12-start blocks from positions 0..n-12, append blocks until n values then truncate, 2000 draws; n<=12 uses whole segment but status insufficient_blocks and cannot pass integration

selection.rule: Among rules satisfying all economic gates in development, select highest mean paired wealth delta. Ties within 1e-10 use candidate registry order. If none qualifies, select none; validation/replication results remain diagnostic and cannot be used to rescue another rule.
selection.confirmation: Frozen winner must separately pass every economic gate against immediate baseline in both later partitions at 1 year, retain positive mean/median improvement under each stress scenario in each later partition, and not lose mean/median terminal wealth to three_tranches in either later partition. 3-year results are auxiliary, never substituted for a failed primary outcome.
selection.uncertainty: Report all monthly counts and non-overlap counts. Use fixed-seed moving-block bootstrap with 12 monthly-start blocks for primary-horizon paired differences, 2000 draws and 2.5/97.5 percentiles; intervals are descriptive under prior exposure and short dependent history, never a future success probability.
selection.integrationGate: No automatic UI score. Only a frozen winner passing economic confirmation, positive lower descriptive mean interval in both later partitions, independent ledger/causality audit and production-equivalent tax/data validation may be proposed for integration. Otherwise keep all candidates in research only. Record all failures; no same-version threshold, portfolio or horizon adjustment.
